schemaDatasetDescription: Reviewed Tucson Unified student and family dates for 2026–27, including the first day, last student day, parent-teacher conference half-days, grading days, professional learning no-school days, Rodeo Break, graduation days, and major breaks. The page also documents TUSD’s weekly Wednesday early-release schedule.
heroSummary: Tucson Unified students begin the 2026–27 school year on Thursday, August 6, 2026. The last day for students is Tuesday, May 25, 2027. Fall break is October 12–16, winter break is December 21–January 1, Rodeo Break is February 25–26, and spring break is March 22–26.
calendarNotes: The official TUSD calendar lists 176 student days: 85 in the first semester and 91 in the second. Students are released one hour early every Wednesday, and parent-teacher conference half-days vary by grade level.

sourceReviewSummary: Dates and year-over-year comparisons on this page were checked against TUSD’s official 2025–26 and 2026–27 calendar PDFs.
sourceReviewDetails: We verified first day, last student day, quarter and semester day counts, fall break, winter break, Rodeo Break, spring break, grading days, professional learning days, parent-teacher conference half-days, graduation days, and student-facing no-school dates against the official TUSD 2026–27 PDF.
The What Changed from 2025–26 comparison uses TUSD’s official 2025–26 calendar PDF, board approved December 11, 2024, and the official 2026–27 calendar PDF, board approved September 16, 2025.
Staff and summer administrative dates are listed separately from the student calendar. The downloadable file includes the listed student dates but does not repeat every Wednesday early-release date.
School-specific testing schedules, bell schedules, transportation notices, athletics, performances, and graduation ceremony details may appear only in school announcements.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The file is a one-time import and does not automatically update if TUSD revises its calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Does this page include school-specific events?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Bell schedules, testing dates, athletics, performances, transportation notices, and ceremony times may be published separately by individual schools.

calendarFaqs.q: Are Wednesday early-release times the same at every school?
calendarFaqs.a: TUSD states that students are released one hour early every Wednesday, but families should check their school’s bell schedule for the exact dismissal time.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can families check for calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Check TUSD’s official calendar page and messages from your child’s school.

Check your school’s bell schedule for the exact dismissal time.

groups.label: Conference half-days vary by grade level
items: K–8 students have parent-teacher conference half-days September 16–18 and February 11–12.
Students in grades 9–12 have conference half-days September 18 and February 12.

groups.label: Rodeo Break is separate from spring break
Grading and professional learning days
items: Students do not attend school on grading days October 9, December 18, and March 19.
January 27 and March 3 are staff professional learning days with no school for students.
